facts.rationale: Corrects the existing opening sentence's inclusion of the shared runtime JObj among archive-loaded destinations while preserving the supported resource and camera data flow.
facts.value: vi1202_Scene_OnEnter loads archive symbols into three module-static pointers: the visual SceneDesc, stand SceneDesc and trophy HSD_Joint. The visual descriptor supplies lights, camera data and a null-terminated model array. During runtime visual-model construction, un_80321178 passes each loaded hierarchy to lb_80011E24 with selection argument 2 and the address of the fourth static pointer, un_804D704C. Trophy and stand setup subsequently consume that selected runtime HSD_JObj in both integration calls. The shared JObj is therefore produced by model setup, not archive-symbol loading. vi1202_RunFrame reads the updated camera AObj frame to dispatch the frame-100 event and independently invoke the ending hooks on exact end-frame equality.
